name: Selling Livestock
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator of all things, including the earth and every living creature, as seen in Genesis 1:1-2. Humanity, made in God's image, is given dominion over the cattle and all animals on earth (Genesis 1:26), which forms the foundation for responsible stewardship in activities such as selling livestock. This stewardship is ultimately grounded in God's love and redemptive plan through Christ, who offers eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16).
